translations.web: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
translations.bsb: It devours patches of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs.
translations.kjv: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
translations.asv: The members of his body shall be devoured, Yea, the first-born of death shall devour his members.
